author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬಿದ್ದವಗೆ ಧ್ವನಿಯಾಗು ನೊಂದವಗೆ ಶಕುತಿಯು
ಸಿದ್ಧನಿರು ಕರಪಿಡಿದು ಮೇಲೆತ್ತುವುದಕೆ
ಗದ್ದಲವನೆಬ್ಬಿಸದೆ ಸೇವೆಯನು ಗೈಯುತಿರೆ
ಮದ್ದೆರೆವೆ ಅಂತರಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Be a voice for the fallen, strength for the hurting;
be ready to take their hand and lift them up;
if you serve without making a noise about it,
you heal the heart within, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Speak up for those who have fallen and support those in pain. Quiet service, done without fanfare, heals the one who serves as much as the one served.
